node.statement: Apply the two cb estimates of 1.2 to the first and third summands in 1.5, the norm bounds of 1.3 to their arguments, and the degree-two estimate 1.4 to the middle summand. The resulting upper bound is C_theta*eta*||X||*||Y||+C_2*eta*||X||*||Y||+C_Delta*eta*||X||*||Y||=(C_2+C_theta+C_Delta)*eta*||X||*||Y||, which is exactly the root conclusion for the arbitrary fixed data; universal generalization proves node 1.
